packages.name: Escape to Coorg
packages.overview: Coorg is one of the most beautiful hill stations on the Western Ghats famous for its surreal vistas and wonderful culture. If you are looking to spend some time amidst quaint coffee plantations and lush landscapes, check the Coorg trip package itinerary from GT Holidays.

itinerary.title: Bangalore
itinerary.description: After arriving in Bangalore, our tour representative will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. After check-in, spend some time relaxing before heading out for a tour of Bengaluru City. You will visit Lal Bagh, Cubbon Park, Vidhana Soudha, and Tipu Sultan’s castle. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Bangalore.

itinerary.title: Bangalore to Coorg
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet, check out of the hotel and head to Coorg. The journey takes around 6 hours and looks mesmerising. Check in to the hotel and spend the rest of the evening relaxing and exploring the area. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Coorg.

itinerary.title: Coorg
itinerary.description: After breakfast in the morning, head out for a tour of Coorg. This beautiful hill station is famous for its coffee and tea plantations and lush greenery. You will visit the Nagarhole National Park, Madikeri Fortress, Iruppu Falls in Brahmagiri, Raja’s Seat Garden, Nunnery Falls, and the Omkareshwara Sanctuary. Return to the hotel to spend the night in Coorg.

itinerary.title: Coorg – Bangalore
itinerary.description: As your Coorg trip package ends, check out of your hotel to head to Bangalore.

packages.name: Spiritual South India Tour
packages.destination: Tirupati – Bangalore – Mysore – Ooty – Madurai – Rameswaram – Kanyakumari
packages.overview: South India is home to some of the country’s most beautiful temples. These temples are not only religiously significant but also places of art and architecture and help preserve Indian cultural heritage. To explore these temples, check the South India spiritual tour package itinerary from GT Holidays.

itinerary.title: Tirupathi
itinerary.description: You will arrive in Tirupathi by train/air to begin your pilgrimage tour. Our tour manager will guide you to the hotel and complete check-in formalities. Spend some time relaxing in the hotel. In the evening, get ready for an optional sightseeing tour of Tirupathi. Spend the night at a hotel in Tirupathi.

itinerary.title: Tirupathi – Bangalore
itinerary.description: After breakfast, prepare for a darshan of the Sri Venkateshwara Swami Temple and the Padmavati Ammavari Temple in Tiruchanur. While the temple of Lord Srinivasa is atop the seven hills at Tirumala, the temple dedicated to Goddess Padmavathi is at Tirupati. It is believed that devotees must first visit Tirupati before seeking blessings from her consort, Lord Balaji. After darshan and lunch, head to Bangalore to continue with your South India spiritual tour package. The journey takes around 6 hours by train and around 4.5 hours by road. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring places around it. Spend the night in Bangalore.

itinerary.title: Bangalore – Mysore
itinerary.description: After a hearty South Indian breakfast, head out for a city tour. Bangalore, or Bengaluru, is the capital of Karnataka. It was founded around 500 years ago by Kempe Gowda I, a Governor under the Vijayanagara Empire. While the old areas of the city included the neighbourhoods of Ulsoor, Malleshwaram, Basavanagudi, and Shivajinagar, Bangalore grew around these places over time. You will visit Cubbon Park, Tippu Sultan’s Summer Palace, The Mayo Hall, Attara Katcheri, Bangalore Palace, and the famous Bull Temple in Basavanagudi. Later, check out of your hotel and head to Mysore for an overnight stay. The journey takes around 2.5 hours by road. Check into the hotel to spend the night in Sandalwood City.

itinerary.title: Mysore – Ooty
itinerary.description: Mysore is Bangalore’s second-most populous city. It was founded in 1399 by two brothers, Yaduraya and Krishnaraya. The town gets its name from the demon Mahishashura, who is believed to have ruled the area and was killed by the Goddess Chamundeshwari. After breakfast, head out for a tour of Mysore City. You will visit Mysore Palace, Chamundeshwari Temple, Somnathapura Temple, Jagmohan Palace and Art Gallery, Lalitha Mahal, Sri Chamarajendra Zoological Gardens, and Brindavan Gardens. Later, check out of the hotel and head to Ooty. The journey takes around 3.5 hours by road. Check into the hotel and spend the night at a luxury hotel in Ooty.

itinerary.title: Ooty
itinerary.description: Ooty, or Uthagamandalam, is part of the Western Ghats and is often described as the Queen of Hills. The town is famous for its toy trains, scenic views of the surrounding mountains, lakes, gardens, and wildlife. After breakfast, you will explore some of Ooty’s top attractions, including the Botanical Gardens, Rose Garden, Doddabetta, Mudumalai Tiger Reserve, Pykara Falls, Avalance Lake, and Tea Factory. Spend the night in Ooty.

itinerary.title: Ooty to Madurai
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, head to Madurai for your temple tour. The journey takes around 7 hours on the way, you will visit Dolphin’s Nose in Coonoor. Check into a hotel and freshen up. Later in the evening, visit the Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple. After Darshan, go shopping at the stalls around the temple before heading to the temple. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Madurai.

itinerary.title: Madurai
itinerary.description: After a breakfast buffet, head out for a sightseeing tour of Temple City. You will visit the Gandhi Museum, Tirumalai Nayakar Palace, Vandiyur Mariamman Teppakulam, Rajaji Park, and Alagarkoil. After shopping and sampling some of Madurai’s famous street foods, spend the night at a luxury hotel in Madurai.

itinerary.title: Rameswaram
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Rameswaram for a pilgrimage to the Ramanathaswamy Temple. Check into the hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, you can go on a sightseeing tour of Rameswaram. You will visit the Pamban Bridge, the many Agraharams around the temple, Dhanushkodi, and the Dr A. P. J Abdul Kalam Memorial. Spend the night in Rameswaram.

itinerary.title: Rameswaram – Kanyakumari
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Kanyakumari for the final leg of your South India spiritual tour package. The journey takes 5.5 hours. Check into a hotel and spend the rest of the day enjoying places around it. You will visit the Gandhi Memorial, the Thiruvalluvar Statue, and the sunset. Spend the night in Kanyakumari.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Today, you will experience the mesmerising sunrise and darshan of the Bhagavathiamman Temple. You will also visit Suchindrum Temple, Thiruvattar Adi Kesava Perumal Temple, and the Padmanabhapuram Palace. Check out of the hotel and head to Coimbatore as your South India spiritual tour package ends.

packages.location: Tirupati – Bangalore – Mysore – Ooty – Madurai – Rameswaram – Kanyakumari

packages.name: Exciting Special Hill Tour Package
packages.overview: Of the many hill stations in Tamil Nadu, Ooty and Kodaikanal are definitely special. While both are part of the Western Ghats, the two are distinct in terms of outdoor activities offered and natural attractions. We’ve made it easy for you to appreciate both places with our Tamil Nadu hill station tour package.

itinerary.title: Bangalore – Mysore
itinerary.description: Upon arrival in Bangalore, our tour manager will welcome and travel with you to Mysore. The journey takes around 3 hours by road and is beautiful thanks to the scenic villages and numerous streetside restaurants selling delicious thatte idli. On the way to the city, you will visit the Chamundi Hills, Mysore Zoo, Brindavan Gardens, Mysore Lake, and the St Philomena Church. Check into a comfortable hotel and spend the night in Mysore.

itinerary.title: Mysore – Ooty
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, head for a scenic road drive to Ooty. It takes about 4 hours to reach Ooty, the Queen of Hill Stations. Check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the evening relaxing or enjoying a night tour of the Ooty Lake. You can also visit the Botanical Gardens. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Ooty.

itinerary.title: Ooty
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, head out to explore Ooty. You will cover the Dodabetta Peak, the Botanical Garden, Ooty Lake, Lamb’s Rock, the Rose Garden, the Tea Factory, the Mudumalai Tiger Reserve, and the Pykara Waterfalls. Spend the night at a hotel in Ooty.

itinerary.title: Ooty – Kodaikanal
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and head to Kodaikanal. The beautiful journey takes around 6 hours, with winding roads meandering through lush forests. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day relaxing and enjoying the places around it. Spend the night in Kodaikanal.

itinerary.title: Kodaikanal
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, head to explore Kodaikanal town. Some famous tourist attractions you will cover include Coaker’s Walk, Green Valley View, Byrant Park, Pillars Rock, Kodai Lake, and Kurinji Andavar Temple. Return to the hotel to spend the rest of the evening exploring the nearby carrot and potato farms.

itinerary.title: Kodaikanal – Bangalore
itinerary.description: Today is the last day of your hill station tour package. After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Bangalore by car.

packages.name: Super Saver Holiday Package
packages.overview: The state of Karnataka has a bunch of elements that make it a preferred travel destination for tourists everywhere. Right from its beaches and pilgrimage sites to the rich heritage, wildlife, hills, and adventurous activities, there is plenty to explore in Karnataka. If you have always wanted to uncover the gems of this southern Indian state, then check out our super saver tour package.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bangalore
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the airport or railway station in Bangalore, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Often referred to as the ‘Silicon Valley of India’, Bangalore is known for its pleasant weather, greenery, and modern lifestyle, among several other things. After checking-in at your hotel, you can venture out to explore the city. Take a stroll around the peaceful Cubbon Park which is sprawled over an area of 300 acres. Visit the Lalbagh Botanical Garden, which is 200 years old and covers 240 acres. The next stop for the day will be Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace, a wonderful example of Indo-Islamic architecture. Visit the Vidhana Soudha, Bangalore Palace, St. Patrick's Church, and Bull Temple before heading back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Bangalore – Mysore
itinerary.description: After having a delicious breakfast, check out of your hotel in Bangalore and leave for the city of Mysore. Check-in to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Mysore City Tour
itinerary.description: Get done with your breakfast and venture out to witness the numerous scenic spots in Mysore. You will be taken to the Chamundi Hills, Brindavan Gardens, Karanji Lake, Mysore Zoo, and St. Philomena's Cathedral. Get back to your hotel for a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Mysore - Coorg
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be leaving Mysore and making your way towards Coorg, which is among the most stunning hill stations in the country. Check-in to your hotel and you will have the rest of the day to relax.

itinerary.title: Coorg
itinerary.description: Today, you will be exploring Coorg, which is known for its tea and coffee plantations and abundant greenery. Get ready to visit popular tourist spots such as the Omkareshwara Temple, Abbey Falls, Raja's Seat, Iruppu Falls, Madikeri Fort, and the Nagarahole Tiger Reserve.

itinerary.title: Coorg – Bangalore – Depart Bangalore
itinerary.description: Have a filling breakfast and leave for the airport or railway station in Bangalore to get back to your hometown.
